    de.drug_concept_id,
    c.concept_name,
    c.vocabulary_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_exposures,
    COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS unique_patients
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
JOIN omop.concept c ON de.drug_concept_id = c.concept_id
WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept 
    WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND standard_concept = 'S' 
    AND (concept_name LIKE '%albuterol%' OR 
         concept_name LIKE '%levalbuterol%' OR 
         concept_name LIKE '%ipratropium%')
)
GROUP BY de.drug_concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;
